mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in FEDFUNDS per annum signals a tightening monetary policy cycle, compressing equity discount rates and leading to negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window, or 20-day returns remain non-negative despite rising FEDFUNDS.

mechanism_narrative: FEDFUNDS crossing above 4.0% per annum triggers a sharp rise in risk-free rates, compressing equity valuations and generating negative 20-day returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly negative (p > 0.05 t-test) despite FEDFUNDS exceeding 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rise in FEDFUNDS above 4.0% per annum and concurrent decline in UNRATE below 4.5% creates dual pressure on growth expectations, driving negative 20-day returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not negative (p > 0.05) despite both proxies meeting the trigger condition.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, a sustained decline in FEDFUNDS signals monetary easing, boosting equity valuations and generating positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) in late-cycle expansion periods despite FEDFUNDS declining.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in UNRATE below 4.0% per month indicates weakening labor market pressures, reducing inflationary risks and supporting equity valuations, leading to positive 5-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 5-day returns not positive (p > 0.05) despite UNRATE declining below 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Convergence of falling UNRATE below 4.0% and rising HOUST employment figures signals labor market strengthening and reduced slack, driving positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not positive (p > 0.05) despite both proxies meeting the trigger condition.

mechanism_narrative: INDPRO crossing above 105.0 triggers a surge in production capacity, leading to positive 60-day S&P 500 returns as investors anticipate sustained growth.
failure_condition: 60-day returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite INDPRO exceeding 105.0.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rise in INDPRO above 105.0 and GDPC1 above 16813.3 (quarterly) signals robust demand-supply balance, driving positive 60-day S&P 500 returns as investors anticipate sustained growth.
